result.brief: 提出模态级在线策略蒸馏框架 OmniOPD，通过非对称噪声调度构造特权视觉信息、分组多噪声采样与时间步重要性加权，缓解音视频联合生成中音频监督稀疏与跨模态干扰，稳定联合蒸馏。
result.reason: On-policy distillation for joint audio-video generation, addressing cross-modal supervision imbalance and audio-video reward interference; directly a joint audio-video generation contribution.
